title: Piracetam in WOREE
summary: A circuit comparator for testing early inhibitory recruitment and late cortical recurrence.
evidence: At 10 µM, rat CA1 events fell from 80 to 18 excitatory potentials per 20 seconds. Evoked pyramidal spikes rose in a different experiment at higher concentrations.
inference: Peripheral CaV2.2-enriched currents gave an IC50 of 3.4 µM. Isolated AMPA receptor domains also bind piracetam. Both routes require testing in juvenile cortex.
hypothesis: An increase in interneuron excitation could strengthen early inhibition. Block of calcium-dependent GABA release could cancel this gain.
experiment: At verified local exposure in juvenile Wwox cortex, compare direct AMPA charge, paired excitatory and inhibitory release, first recruitment and late recurrence.
limits: Five children in an opsoclonus–myoclonus crossover showed no significant video-rated improvement. Neural exposure and seizure outcomes in WOREE remain unresolved.
